You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 78b40b8e4ec0a6bb4bc63fc3164ca0ee6810f8bb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jean-Francois Wald <jean-francois-j.wald@edf.fr>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2019 08:43:46 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] GUI : fix bug in writers activation by formula introduced in
 commit b756face

---
 src/gui/cs_gui_output.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/gui/cs_gui_output.c b/src/gui/cs_gui_output.c
index 7bf8aacef..8b3ab6c51 100644
--- a/src/gui/cs_gui_output.c
+++ b/src/gui/cs_gui_output.c
@@ -633,7 +633,7 @@ cs_gui_postprocess_activate(void)
 
     const char *frequency_choice
       = cs_tree_node_get_tag(cs_tree_node_get_child(tn, "frequency"),
-                             "perio");
+                             "period");
 
     if (cs_gui_strcmp(frequency_choice, "formula")) {
       const char *formula = cs_tree_node_get_child_value_str(tn, "frequency");
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a typo in the key used to retrieve a tag from a tree node. The original code attempted to access the tag "perio" instead of the correct tag "period", which led to incorrect behavior in the activation of writers by formula. This issue was introduced in a previous commit (b756face) and was fixed by correcting the key used in the function `cs_tree_node_get_tag`.

    <text1>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a typo in the key used to retrieve a tag from a tree node. The original code attempted to access the tag "perio" instead of the correct tag "period", which led to incorrect behavior in the activation of writers by formula. This issue was introduced in a previous commit (b756face) and was fixed by correcting the key used in the function `cs_tree_node_get_tag`.

From 78b40b8e4ec0a6bb4bc63fc3164ca0ee6810f8bb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jean-Francois Wald <jean-francois-j.wald@edf.fr>

+++ b/src/gui/cs_gui_output.c
@@ -633,7 +633,7 @@ cs_gui_postprocess_activate(void)
 
     const char *frequency_choice
       = cs_tree_node_get_tag(cs_tree_node_get_child(tn, "frequency"),
-                             "perio");
+                             "period");
 
     if (cs_gui_strcmp(frequency_choice, "formula")) {
       const char *formula = cs_tree_node_get_child_value_str(tn, "frequency");
